question: When is the TAFC application due?
expected: There is no fixed deadline: applications are accepted on a rolling basis until all program funds are obligated, with awards made at CWCB's Board meetings six times a year. Applicants must contact the CWCB to discuss the project before applying.
quote: Applications to the TAFC program will be accepted on a rolling basis

question: Who can apply for a TAFC grant?
expected: Governmental entities (municipalities, districts, enterprises and counties) and private entities such as mutual ditch companies, non-profit corporations and partnerships. State agencies are generally not eligible except in limited cases at staff discretion, and covered entities must have an approved water conservation plan.
quote: Governmental entities including municipalities, districts, enterprises, and counties.
